dedupe_keys.name: veviurko evcp partially observable locations surrogate dc microgrid models for optimization of charging electric vehicles under partial observability

description: Grigorii Veviurko and colleagues publish a surrogate DC-microgrid model for optimising electric-vehicle charging when charger locations or network state are partly observed. Zenodo archives the publication branch under MIT, and the linked repository gives a Python 3.8 environment, requirements and example setup. It combines a microgrid surrogate with an optimisation problem for charging decisions, so modellers can study how incomplete location information changes feasible charging schedules. No catalogue record explicitly covers this release. A limitation is that the source is a research implementation, not a calibrated operating model for a named charging network. Its README says MOSEK may require a separate licence, so acquiring the open code does not ensure cost-free execution of every optimisation path. Repository code can differ from the archived branch. No environment was installed, and no surrogate or charging result was reproduced.
